payload.title: The 2025/26 accounts: £0.710m under on services, £38.3m of building work not done
payload.summary: The draft accounts for 2025/26 report a General Fund underspend of £0.710m — 1.03% of the gross General Fund expenditure budget — and a Housing Revenue Account underspend of £4.223m, 5.08%. Capital spending was £56.477m against a budget of £94.768m, so £38.291m of approved building work did not happen that year.
detail: The council names £1.286m of interest on its day-to-day cash as contributing to a £2.992m underspend in Corporate Financing, the central pot.
Service departments went over budget by £2.282m; the central pot covered it. That has happened three years running.
The accounts are draft, which means the external auditor has not signed them off.
